title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and former leader of the Orzhov Syndicate, who returns to Ravnica for a gala in her honor and is pressed by Teysa to repay her debts.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The newest head of the Orzhov Syndicate and host of the gala at Karlov Manor, who uses a walking cane.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: A massive archon who leads the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations after the invasion.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The current head of the Azorius Senate, who converses with Ezrim at the gala.

entities.name: Tolsimir
entities.description: A guild leader who insists Lazav is not dead.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A winged angel who argues that the Boros should handle the investigation.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A guild leader dressed in black and red who needles Kaya about the invasion.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: A former Orzhov leader married to Ral who is Teysa's aide at the gala.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Izzet who grieves the invasion's losses and is Tomik's husband.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A slim, dark-haired Agency investigator honored for containing Anzrag, who befriends Kaya at the gala.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A guild figure at odds with Vannifar who mistakes Kellan for a detective named Proft.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: A guild leader who unseated Zegana's predecessor.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A gaudily dressed goblin who owes money to the Karlovs and networks at the gala.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Gruul centaur who tries to reclaim the god Anzrag and is dragged away.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: A Gruul god that broke loose and rampaged in the Ninth District before being contained in an evidence capsule.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir figure Tolsimir believes is still alive and planning something.

entities.name: Proft
entities.description: A detective people have been talking about whom Zegana thinks Kellan might be.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought on New Phyrexia and lost, according to Kaya.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A friend on Kaldheim adjusting to new limitations.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-run city plane where the gala takes place.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Teysa Karlov's lavish manor and the site of the gala.

entities.name: Ninth District
entities.description: A district devastated by Anzrag.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The district where the Orzhov bought every pyrowork.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-controlled plane where the multiversal fight took place.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane Kaya could visit.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane Kaya could visit.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane Kaya could visit.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane Kaya could visit.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that Kaya's spark can cross.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild of lawmages and wealth that hosts the gala.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild led by Lavinia.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of Aurelia, which wants the investigation.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A guild that worships Anzrag.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of Ral and the pyroworks.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A guild that values social acumen.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The absent guild of secrets.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: A new investigative body led by Ezrim, honored at the gala.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who attacked Ravnica.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The recent attack on Ravnica and the Multiverse that left chaos and loss.

events.summary: The Orzhov launch an extravagant fireworks display above Karlov Manor to open the gala.
events.quote: The sky over Karlov Manor danced with a dizzying array of colors, brought to life by shimmering cascades of magic.

events.summary: Kaya joins Teysa on the manor's highest balcony.
events.quote: Soundless as ever, Kaya stepped up next to her, stopping when she reached the rail.

events.summary: Teysa reminds Kaya that she owes the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
events.quote: You owe me this night, Kaya.

events.summary: Teysa demands that Kaya obey her through the evening.
events.quote: So tonight, you smile when I say smile, and you bow when I say bow

events.summary: Teysa leads Kaya into the courtyard crowd of Ravnica's elite.
events.quote: settling one hand on the taller woman's shoulder in a proprietary fashion

events.summary: Teysa explains that Ezrim leads the Agency after the invasion and has drawn away Azorius associates.
events.quote: Imagine her displeasure when after the invasion, he took on leadership.

events.summary: An Orzhov server recognizes Kaya as the former leader and the Planeswalker.
events.quote: Our former leader. The Planeswalker.

events.summary: Tolsimir insists that Lazav is not dead and is planning something.
events.quote: It's naive to think that Lazav is dead.

events.summary: Kaya defends the fight against the invasion when Judith needles her.
events.quote: We didn't start the invasion, we stopped it

events.summary: Judith falters when she sees the wall behind Kaya's eyes.
events.quote: There was a wall behind the Planeswalker's eyes that hadn't been there on their last meeting

events.summary: Teysa addresses the courtyard from the balcony.
events.quote: Citizens of Ravnica, welcome to Karlov Manor!

events.summary: Teysa celebrates Kaya as a hero of the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: Tonight, we celebrate Orzhov's own former leader, Kaya, for her role in the salvation of Ravnica and the Multiverse during the Phyrexian invasion

events.summary: Teysa announces a tribute to the Agency.
events.quote: tonight we honor the members of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

events.summary: Ezrim recounts how Investigator Kellan's team stopped the god Anzrag's rampage.
events.quote: a Gruul god broke loose of guild control and wreaked havoc across the Ninth District.

events.summary: Ezrim honors Kellan, who flees the balcony.
events.quote: The Agency thanks you, Ravnica thanks you, and I thank you

events.summary: Kaya recalls Jace's defeat on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: He fought as hard as he could, but he lost. And because of that, we all lost.

events.summary: Zegana mistakes Kellan for the detective Proft.
events.quote: Are you quite sure you're not that detective Proft everyone's been talking about?

events.summary: Kellan seeks out Kaya to escape the crowd and they bond over discomfort.
events.quote: Getting out of here

events.summary: Teysa presses Krenko about the debt he owes the Karlovs.
events.quote: Think, Krenko. You owe the Karlovs.

events.summary: Yarus is dragged off the balcony shouting that Anzrag must be returned to the Gruul.
events.quote: Anzrag is our responsibility, our god, and he must be returned to us!

events.summary: Aurelia demands the Boros take over the investigation, provoking a scoff from Kellan.
events.quote: This investigation should be in the hands of the Boros.

events.summary: Kaya slips away from the argument at the buffet.
events.quote: She ducked around the buffet and through the door on the other side

events.summary: Kaya considers leaving Ravnica by planeswalking but stops herself.
events.quote: She felt herself begin to reach, desire becoming reality, and stopped

events.summary: Teysa finds Kaya alone and says she has something important to tell her.
events.quote: There's something I need to tell you. Something important. And I needed to catch you alone.

events.summary: A scream from inside the manor interrupts Teysa.
events.quote: Teysa started to reply as a scream rang out from inside the manor, drowning out her words and shattering the moment.

events.summary: Kaya runs toward the scream.
events.quote: Kaya didn't pause to think before running toward the sound.
